#LOAD PACKAGES 

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(qs)
library(ewastools)
library(ggpubr)
library(qqman)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
library(methylGSA)

```

#IMPORT EWAS RESULTS

```{r}

#M1: Demographic
load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_childrural_demographic.rda")
demographic_rural <- results_rural_cannotated
rm(results_rural_cannotated)
demographic_rural <- demographic_rural %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_schlyrs_demographic.rda")
demographic_schlyrs <- results_schlyrs_cannotated
rm(results_schlyrs_cannotated)
demographic_schlyrs <- demographic_schlyrs %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_livegpar_demographic.rda")
demographic_livegpar <- results_livegpar_cannotated
rm(results_livegpar_cannotated)
demographic_livegpar <- demographic_livegpar %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_chsmk_demographic.rda")
demographic_chsmk <- results_chsmk_cannotated
rm(results_chsmk_cannotated)
demographic_chsmk <- demographic_chsmk %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

#M2: Health 
load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_childrural_hm.rda")
h_rural <- results_rural_hannotated
rm(results_rural_hannotated)
h_rural <- h_rural %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_schlyrs_h.rda")
h_schlyrs <- results_schlyrs_hannotated
rm(results_schlyrs_hannotated)
h_schlyrs <- h_schlyrs %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_livegpar_h.rda")
h_livegpar <- results_livegpar_hannotated
rm(results_livegpar_hannotated)
h_livegpar <- h_livegpar %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_chsmk_h.rda")
h_chsmk <- results_chsmk_hannotated
rm(results_chsmk_hannotated)
h_chsmk <- h_chsmk %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

#M3: Socioeconomic and behavior 
load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm3_rural_ds8.rda")
rural_smk_8 <- results_rural_ds8annotated
rm(results_rural_ds8annotated)
rural_m3 <- rural_smk_8 %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm3_schlyrs_ds9.rda")
schlyrs_m3 <- results_schlyrs_ds9annotated
rm(results_schlyrs_ds9annotated)
schlyrs_m3 <- schlyrs_m3 %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm3_livegpar_ds10.rda")
livegpar_smk_10 <- results_livegpar_ds10annotated
rm(results_livegpar_ds10annotated)
livegpar_m3 <- livegpar_smk_10 %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm3_chsmk_ds.rda")
chsmk_ds <- results_chsmk_dsannotated
rm(results_chsmk_dsannotated)
chsmk_m3 <- chsmk_ds %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

rm(rural_smk_8, livegpar_smk_10, chsmk_ds)

```

## LOAD IN FUNCTIONS

```{r}

source('EWAS_function.R')

```

# GENE SET ENRICHMENT

### M1/Demographic

```{r}

cpg_pvalues <- demographic_rural$P.Value
names(cpg_pvalues) <- demographic_rural$CpG
gsa_result1 <- methylGSA::methylRRA(cpg.pval = cpg_pvalues,
                               array.type = "EPIC",
                               method = "GSEA")

cpg_pvalues <- demographic_schlyrs$P.Value
names(cpg_pvalues) <- demographic_schlyrs$CpG
gsa_result2 <- methylGSA::methylRRA(cpg.pval = cpg_pvalues,
                               array.type = "EPIC",
                               method = "GSEA")

cpg_pvalues <- demographic_livegpar$P.Value
names(cpg_pvalues) <- demographic_livegpar$CpG
gsa_result3 <- methylGSA::methylRRA(cpg.pval = cpg_pvalues,
                               array.type = "EPIC",
                               method = "GSEA")

cpg_pvalues <- demographic_chsmk$P.Value
names(cpg_pvalues) <- demographic_chsmk$CpG
gsa_result4 <- methylGSA::methylRRA(cpg.pval = cpg_pvalues,
                               array.type = "EPIC",
                               method = "GSEA")


```

### M3/Socioeconomic and Behavior


## EXPORT

```{r}

sheets_methylGSA = list('childrural(Demographic)' = gsa_result1, 'childrural(Health)' = gsa_result5, 'childrural(SES+Behavior)' = gsa_result9, 'SCHLYRS(Demographic)' = gsa_result2, 'SCHLYRS(Health)' = gsa_result6, 'SCHLYRS(SES+Behavior)' = gsa_result10, 'LIVEGPAR(Demographic)' = gsa_result3, 'LIVEGPAR(Health)' = gsa_result7, 'LIVEGPAR(SES+Behavior)' = gsa_result11, 'CHSMOKE(Demographic)' = gsa_result4, 'CHSMOKE(Health)' = gsa_result8, 'CHSMOKE(SES+Behavior)' = gsa_result12)
writexl::write_xlsx(sheets_methylGSA, 'Manuscript/EWAS/Supplemental Table 10-Gene Ontology Pathway Enrichment Results.xlsx')

```


## UPSET PLOT
```{r}

### Remove rownames
rownames(gsa_result9) <- NULL
rownames(gsa_result10) <- NULL
rownames(gsa_result11) <- NULL
rownames(gsa_result12) <- NULL

### Subset columns for plotting
gsa_rural3 <- dplyr::select(gsa_result9, "Description", "Size", "enrichmentScore", "NES", "pvalue", "padj")
gsa_schlyrs3 <- dplyr::select(gsa_result10, "Description", "Size", "enrichmentScore", "NES", "pvalue", "padj")
gsa_livegpar3 <- dplyr::select(gsa_result11, "Description", "Size", "enrichmentScore", "NES", "pvalue", "padj")
gsa_chsmk3 <- dplyr::select(gsa_result12, "Description", "Size", "enrichmentScore", "NES", "pvalue", "padj")

### Compare top sites across exposures
png(here("Manuscript/GSEA_upsetplot_plessthan0.0001.png"), width=7, height=5, units='in', res=300)

upset(fromList(
  list("Grew up in a rural area" = gsa_rural3$CpG[gsa_rural3$pvalue < 0.0001],
        "Years in school" = gsa_schlyrs3$CpG[gsa_schlyrs3$pvalue < 0.0001],
        "Live with a grandparent" = gsa_livegpar3$CpG[gsa_livegpar3$pvalue < 0.0001],
        "Smoking during childhood" = gsa_chsmk3$CpG[gsa_chsmk3$pvalue < 0.0001])
    ), nsets=4)

dev.off()

```
